description: Skill-activation log plus the write-as-me gate. The log records every skill activation and every writing-judge subagent run. The gate blocks calls that ship text under the engineer's name (git commit, gh pr create/edit/comment/review, gh api writes to pulls or comments, stack submits, github mcp pr and comment tools, edits that add code comments) until a writing-judge run in this session covers the text; one judge loop covers one shipped text.
